headline: Committee agreed unanimously that Lothrop St. should get paid parking as a revenue recommendation.
summary: The committee reviewed its work timeline and discussed public engagement plans for the deficit reduction process. Members presented research on topics including cannabis revenue, city vehicle use, regional dispatch savings, PILOT agreements, CHARM recycling facilities, enterprise funds (harbor, golf, airport), municipal utility regionalization, and employee health insurance changes. The group agreed that Lothrop Street should have paid parking as a revenue idea, and discussed next steps including starting a PILOT committee request to the council.
decisions: Committee members present unanimously agreed to recommend paid parking on Lothrop Street as a new revenue source.

decision_evidence.quote: Committee agrees unanimously with those present this is a definite recommendation for new revenue.
